01: Everything around you was made by someone.
And every custom piece starts the same way: with guesswork.
02: And it still comes out too heavy, too weak, or impossible to make.
03: An AI artisan for anything that gets made.
Say what you want, and get something that can actually be made.
04: The AI listens and reasons, but it never draws, and never invents a number.
Code builds the real 3D model, measures it, and checks that it can be made.
05: Every craft plugs in as a pack.
Only the rules change. The engine stays.
06: We proved it first in a jeweller's shop.
And out come three castable designs, made from exactly the customer's old gold.
07: If something can't be made, it says no, and offers real options.
If a request is vague, it asks.
09: Next, Karigar moves into Nonilion rooms.
Make it two grams lighter, and it re-solves in seconds.
